paid homage to him sat down to one side and said to him is it the case remember sir that the dwelling of a trainee is itself the same as the tatar gathers dwelling or is it rather that the dwelling of a trainee is one thing and the tata gathers dwelling is another and the buddha said it is not the case when mahanama that the dwelling of a trainee is itself the same as the tata gata's dwelling rather the dwelling of a trainee is one thing and the tata gathers dwelling is another friend mahanama those monks who are trainees who have not attained their minds ideal who dwell aspiring for the unsurpassed security from bondage dwell having abandoned the five hindrances what five the hindrances of sensual desire ill will sloth and topper restlessness and remorse and doubt those monks who are trainees dwell having abandoned these five hindrances for those monks who are arahants whose assabats are destroyed who have lived who have lived the holy life done what had to be done lay down the burden reach their own goal utterly destroy the fetus of existence become completely liberated through final knowledge the five hindrances have been abandoned cut off at the root made like palm stumps obliterated so that they are no more subject to future arising but five the hindrances of sensual desire ill will sloth and topper restlessness and remorse and doubt for those monks who are arahants
